instruction: In the pool at the gate of the sunrise, inside the wall, at the foot of the column that stands in its middle, 4 cubits: [deposit].
context: Redacted site description: a Roman provincial town on a basalt plateau, with a rectangular circuit wall and a gate on each side. Nineteenth-century travellers describe several large rain-water reservoirs in and near the town; their notes are brief and do not always agree.

features.notes: One of two reservoirs beside the east gate, apparently inside the wall; the travellers describe the two together and do not say which lies where. An old column is set upright in its centre (one traveller took the columns for water-level gauges).
A pool beside the north gate (one brief mention); size and form not recorded.

features.dimensions: about 100 paces round and about 9 m deep (one traveller)
features.notes: Large, deep, lined with small stones, roughly round. Near the centre of the town and near the theatre; on the published plan north-east of a square temple.
